paper.title: Online Learning of Rested and Restless Bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Rested bandit problem with Markovian rewards and multiple plays
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Markovian (rested Markov chain) arms are out of scope from ontology v0.5.
unmapped: Each arm is a finite-state irreducible aperiodic Markov chain whose state is frozen unless played; reward is a positive function of the state
Regret compares with always playing the M arms of highest stationary mean reward (weak regret)
settings.definition_quote: The $i$th arm is modeled as a discrete-time, irreducible and aperiodic Markov chain with finite state space $S^i$... the state of a rested arm changes according to $P^i$ only when it is played and remains frozen otherwise.

settings.name_in_paper: Restless bandit problem with Markovian rewards and multiple plays
settings.out_of_scope_reason: Markovian (restless Markov chain) arms are out of scope from ontology v0.5.
unmapped: Each arm is a finite-state irreducible aperiodic Markov chain that evolves regardless of play; state observed only when played
Regret compares with always playing the M arms of highest stationary mean reward (weak regret)
settings.definition_quote: By contrast, the state of a restless arm changes according to $P^i$ regardless of the user's actions.

symbols.L_expl: exploration constant L of the index
symbols.mu_i: stationary mean reward of suboptimal arm i

conditions: Condition 1: finite-state irreducible aperiodic chains with irreducible multiplicative symmetrizations and positive rewards

source.label: lemma:rev1
source.quote: Under UCB-M with $L \geq 112 S^2_{\max} r^2_{\max} \hat{\pi}^2_{\max} /\epsilon_{\min}$, for any suboptimal arm $i$, we have E[T^i(n)] \leq M + \frac{4L\ln n}{(\mu^{M}-\mu^i)^2} + \sum_{j=1}^M \frac{(|S^i|+|S^{j}|)\beta}{\pi_{\min}}

results.notes: Bound on expected number of plays of a suboptimal arm. Paper's M (plays per step) mapped to m.

bound.expression: 4*L_expl*log(T)*sum_subopt((mu_1 - mu_i)/(mu_M - mu_i)**2) + sum_subopt((mu_1 - mu_i)*(m + C_sum_i)) + C_SPr

symbols.mu_i: stationary mean reward of arm i
symbols.C_SPr: constant depending on state spaces, rewards and transition probabilities (Lemma 4)

conditions: Condition 1: finite-state irreducible aperiodic rested chains with irreducible multiplicative symmetrizations and positive rewards

source.label: thm:mainrested
source.quote: Assume Condition 1 holds and all arms are rested. With constant $L \geq 112 S^2_{\max} r^2_{\max} \hat{\pi}^2_{\max} /\epsilon_{\min}$ the regret of UCB-M is upper bounded by R(n) \leq 4L\ln n \sum_{i>M} \frac{(\mu^{1}-\mu^i)}{(\mu^{M}-\mu^i)^2} + \sum_{i>M} (\mu^{1}-\mu^i) (M + \sum_{j=1}^M C_{i,j}) + C_{\mathbf{S,P,r}}

results.notes: Regret defined as n*sum of top-M stationary means minus expected collected reward; comparator is the best fixed set of M arms. Tuning of L requires knowledge of chain parameters (not in vocabulary).

bound.expression: 4*L_expl*log(T)*sum_subopt(((mu_1 - mu_i)*D_i + E_i)/(mu_M - mu_i)**2) + sum_subopt(((mu_1 - mu_i)*D_i + E_i)*(1 + m*C_sum_i)) + F_const

symbols.mu_i: stationary mean reward of arm i
symbols.D_i: 1/pi^i_min + M^i_max + 1 (M^i_max: max mean hitting time of arm i)

conditions: Condition 1: finite-state irreducible aperiodic restless chains with irreducible multiplicative symmetrizations and positive rewards

source.label: thm:restless1
source.quote: Assume Condition 1 holds and all arms are restless. With constant $L \geq 112 S^2_{\max} r^2_{\max} \hat{\pi}^2_{\max} /\epsilon_{\min}$ the regret of RCA-M is upper bounded by R(n) < 4L \ln n \sum_{i>M} \frac{1}{(\mu^{M}-\mu^i)^2}((\mu^{1}-\mu^i) D_i + E_i) + \sum_{i>M} ((\mu^{1}-\mu^i)D_i+E_i) (1+ M \sum_{j=1}^M C_{i,j}) +F

results.notes: Strict inequality in paper. M^i_max in the statement denotes the max mean hitting time (Omega^i_max in the notation section). Lemma 6 bounds the sum_i (mu^1-mu^i)E[T^i(n)] part and is subsumed.
